root: ^Petra: My sister has returned... I never doubted you would come through for us...
^Glad she's safe... those thieves put up quite a fight...
^ Those thieves could have targeted my brother, or even my mother...

c-0: ^Petra: That only proves your true strength in the face of danger... and shows just how reckless my sister has been.
^I’ll make sure she understands the risks she’s been taking.
c-1: ^Petra: You’re right. Thanks to you, those scoundrels felt fear like never before.
^Our little corner of Slepbone will be safer... at least for now.

g-1: ^Petra: You are a true friend to our family. Please, rest at our camp whenever you need—consider this a small token of our gratitude.
